name: tg-file
doc: Telegram file path end-to-end (FANG-43 shape): a document update arrives, the adapter calls getFile then downloads /file/bot<token>/<path>. Needs `fangrig up tg-file --tg`, THEN `fangrig agent probe`, THEN `fangrig tg-send document` — deliberately no pre-queued 'updates' here: default_agent only resolves once the named agent exists (see the comment in `fangrig agent`), so anything delivered before that exists routes to whatever the daemon's persisted bindings fall back to instead, not to this scenario's stub.
